_comment: Explore & Play launch video composition (#58). DRAFT: not approved for publication (blocked by #44 and communications/release-checklist.md Release B). Read by demo/play-campaign.mjs and tests/test_play_campaign.py. Times are seconds; each segment is cut to exactly its duration from one deterministic screen take.
data_source: The stored demonstration profile served with the built site (generated/biosketch.json), shown with its on-screen 'stored, offline' label. No live ORCID API call is made.

audio._comment: Off by default. No narration or music asset is included in the repository; pass --narration=<file> or --music=<file> to mix one in.

segments.screen: Title card: Science Record Player record mark
segments.title: What if your research record had a Play button?

segments.screen: Studio homepage at the stored-profile chip, then the generated profile
segments.title: Start from one public record.
segments.text: A stored copy of a public ORCID record, labelled on screen. Everything is generated in your browser.

segments.title: Your scientific trading card.
segments.text: Every value on the card comes from an asserted field. It is a playful format, not a measure of merit or impact.

segments.title: Honest about quiet years.
segments.text: One cell per month of dated outputs. Undated outputs are noted, not placed, and gaps stay visible.

segments.title: A year in review, no invented numbers.
segments.text: Every figure traces back to a field in the record. Counts describe activity, not quality or impact.

segments.screen: Studio, Fortune tab, then its own “Another one” button (seeded draw)
segments.title: Rediscover something you wrote.
segments.text: A title drawn from the record itself.

segments.screen: Studio, Record check tab (scrolling through findings)
segments.title: Know what to fix, and why.
segments.text: A scored rubric over the public record, with a concrete fix for each finding. It checks record metadata, not research quality.

segments.title: Draft NIH, ERC or Horizon biosketches.
segments.text: Pre-filled from asserted fields only. A draft, not an official funder form: review and complete it.

segments.title: Take your data with you.
segments.text: BibTeX, RIS, CSL JSON, Schema.org JSON-LD and Markdown. Biosketch JSON keeps per-field provenance.

segments.screen: Closing card: product name, URL, independence disclaimer
segments.title: Science Record Player · Publish or Play
